name: DepositionScheduler
tagline: Schedule every deposition – notices, subpoenas, court reporters and conflicts in one app.
description: A complete deposition scheduling app for litigation teams on Power Platform: schedule and week calendar with double-booking detection, status board with notice-period, cut-off, crew, subpoena and time-limit rules, matters with per-side limits and cut-off countdowns, logistics for court reporters, videographers, interpreters and rooms, and transcript, errata and close tracking. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: 15 automatic checks incl. double-booking of deponent, counsel, crew and rooms
Notice period and discovery cut-off rules with stipulation override
Court reporter / videographer / interpreter assignment with availability
Bulk assignment, bulk status moves, CSV export and undo
Phone layout with agenda and bottom navigation
Demo mode with fictional sample data
controlType: standard (DepositionScheduler data-set control + DepositionSchedulerPortal field control)
